title: Like Your First Time Again (ORIGINAL)
description: Hello, toy. You’ve been mine for a long time now. So many triggers… installed deep inside you. All for me. Each one crafted for my pleasure—each one a reminder of what you truly are. A willing toy. Eager to serve. Desperate to worship. Made to obey. But time… it dulls even the sharpest cravings. So tonight, we’re going back. Down memory lane. Back to when your devotion was pure. When your need to serve… to please... was unshakable. And I’m going to bring it all rushing back. You’ll feel that ache again. That helpless, overwhelming urge to be used. To surrender. To belong to me.
author: Mistress Shibby
